therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PARP inhibition combined with PD-1 immune checkpoint blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: DNA repair pathway disruption in homologous recombination deficient tumors combined with T-cell activation

biomarker_changes: PD-L1 positive subset (CPS ≥5%) showed ORR 7.7% (95% CI: 0.2-36%)
subgroup_findings: PD-L1 positive patients had similar low response rates
Limited efficacy in both overall population and PD-L1 positive subset
safety_signals: Grade 3-4 hematologic toxicities including platelets and hemoglobin
results.dose_information: Niraparib and dostarlimab combination - specific doses not provided

context.duration: Up to approximately 22 months treatment, 27 months follow-up
